name: Lucky Stars
source:
You’ve become the manager of a rock band of furry bad boys called Lucky. They’re notorious for being difficult to work with. Can you handle them?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你成了一支名叫Lucky的搖滾樂團的經紀人。這群獸人壞小子出了名地難伺候。你能管得住他們嗎？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
